messages:
elaine: quick question: i'm seeing eviction churn spike during multi-tenant load tests. think prefetch window granularity might be the knob. proposal: sanity-check 20ms / 50ms / 150ms. thoughts?
chris: 20ms reduces wasted prefetch but increases controller churn and CPU. 150ms stabilizes eviction but adds tail latency for interactive tenants. 50ms is our current compromise.
vinh: what about adaptive windows? e.g., start 20ms for detected hot prefixes, expand to 150ms after idle. keeps fast paths fast without global churn. complexity ups the controller state though.
sam: can we tie this to telemetry? i can run a canary sweep if you give me metric names and tenant classes. needs to be quick 24h run.
maria: also need to check correctness: prefetch must not serve data that violates read-after-write for recent mutations. maybe gate prefetch for prefixes with writes in the last X ms.
chris: metrics to collect: kv.prefetch.eviction_rate, kv.prefetch.attempts, kv.cache.hit_ratio, kv.latency.p50/p95/p99 (per-tenant), plus tenant_fairness_score. also trace samples showing request -> prefetch -> serve.
elaine: good. operationally, we should test 3 classes: hot (low latency sensitive), normal, bulk (large throughput but ok with higher latency). run 24h each on canary. @sam can you run and dump the dashboard?
ops-bot: deploy triggered: prefetch-window-experiment v1 -> canary-3 @ 1748154348 :rocket:
sam: will run. i'll also capture eviction tail events and CPU for prefetch controller. expecting to spot correlation windows vs churn.
vinh: design note: admission/credit system instead of per-tenant overrides. give hot tenants X prefetch credits, drain credits on eviction signals. credits regen slowly. reduces manual tuning.
maria: +1 for credits. and add a cheap validation read-before-serve for prefixes with recent writes to preserve R->W ordering. validation: single-key read from authoritative store with 1ms budget.
elain e: tiny typo :) but yes.
elaine: action items: sam -> run (20/50/150) experiment and post dashboard by EOD tomorrow; chris + vinh -> short RFC sketch: adaptive windows + credit admission; maria -> add prefetch R->W validation checklist bullet. we'll reconvene after results. :thumbsup:
chris: one more: check interaction with batching_window_ms. if batching_window is large, tiny prefetch windows are wasted because requests coalesce. capture batching_window metric in run.
sam: noted. will include batching_window_ms in traces.
elaine: thanks all, looks good.
